name: Caesar Pasta Salad with Tomatoes, Cucumber, Pine Nuts & Eggs
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, quarter eggs and set aside.
Wash, dry, trim, and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Add cheese, dressing, and pine nuts to the bowl, then stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Top with eggs and enjoy!
author: Mealime
